international.title: Fort Hood survivors denied bid to witness shooter’s firing-squad execution
international.summary: Army says trio injured in 2009 attack were not direct victims of Nidal Hasan’s and thus cannot attend event Three survivors of the shooting at Fort Hood will not be allowed to witness the execution by military firing squad of Nidal Hasan who shot 13 people dead in the attack at the Texas army post in 2009, military officials said Tuesday. Hasan was found guilty of multiple counts of murder and attempted murder related to those killed and the more than 30 who were wounded by gunfire in the attack. Continue reading...
